blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style wall-mounted hanging sign. It consists of a horizontal light-wood beam capped with a dark metal mounting bracket on one end, from which a shield-shaped sign hangs suspended by two dark iron straps. The face of the shield has a cream wooden board bordered by reddish-brown wood, featuring a sculpted green thread spool overlapped by a pair of golden scissors. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures.
blind.from_above: A horizontal wooden beam with two dark grey metal collar bands and a rectangular mounting plate on the right, with the rounded golden relief of the scissors/spool bulging out slightly in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.8 feet tall (roughly one-third the height of the figure) and about 2.2 feet wide.
